title: SSV Silver Gull — Sundowner Net
description:
The Sundowner Net — a pirate darknet run out of the casino-city on Sundowner, reachable from any terminal with a bad enough conscience. Press B to open it.

Four tabs. Wallet turns coin into Obols and back, at the house's spread. Exchange is a simulated stock market of eight listings that genuinely reacts to the state of the galaxy — including the party's own faction standing — where companies rise, crash, go under and are replaced. Pit is eight house games, half of them run off your character's ability checks. Wire is the news and rumour feed that leaks what is coming, mixed with plants and noise.

Each player gets a set number of trades and gambles per day; the GM advances the day.

recommends.reason: Salvage Chits hand out real trade goods through the shop's item granter, and the exchange can price a chit prize from the shop catalogue.
The market reads the party's faction standing, so what the crew do in play moves prices. Without it the terminal reports faction telemetry offline.
Wire rumours are attributed to the settlement NPCs who would actually be spreading them.
